Resumen: We are investigating reduced payment conversion on Transbank (Chile). Approval rate on completed transactions remains within nominal range. The degradation is attributable to an elevated rate of transactions not reaching a final state within the expected processing window, not to an increase in declines. Root cause analysis is in progress with the processor. Updates to follow.
